decision.ingress: MIGRATE aggregate string splitting to bounded byte framing and duplicate-aware JSON preflight

counterexamples: one large fetch chunk containing 100 individually bounded events rejected
CRLF with one-byte UTF-8 chunks silently dropped
UTF-8 event over 65536 bytes admitted when UTF-16 length fit
malformed JSON exposed private-marker in error
incomplete UTF-8 at EOF silently discarded

followup_red.counterexample: pending reader cancellation retained the last admitted projection after parser failure
followup_red.correction: clear projection and wire buffer before awaiting cancellation

checks.wire_tests: 4 PASS: 36 valid lexical/chunk cases; 30 invalid JSON/depth cases; invalid UTF-8/history cases; comments/multiline handling
checks.installed_public_client: 39 client + 16 transport PASS; installed client/wire/validators/declarations byte-equal to tested build

bounds.sse_profile: LF/CRLF; optional matching scene/health/gap name; all data lines joined; comments inert; no ID/retry/BOM/bare-CR support

negative_evidence: Producer service/events.py checks JSON payload size only. Exactly 65536 bytes of synthetic JSON exceeds the client raw-event bound after SSE framing. Rejection fixture preserved; producer reconciliation needed.
Reader cancellation is awaited without its own deadline. State now clears first, but promise completion and subsequent DELETE may still stall.
Session-response byte bounds and lexical integer-form enforcement remain unaudited/unimplemented in this slice.
This is not a general EventSource implementation. Unsupported framing is rejected rather than silently admitted.
Alternative language runtime artifacts were not benchmarked. Technology decision is based on deployment, protocol semantics, bounded-memory implementation and executed counterexamples.
limits: No live-server, browser or hardware qualification
No full repository matrix, full fuzz, VM, Docker or clean clone
Buffer cap does not bound allocations performed upstream by fetch or guarantee physical memory erasure
next_task: Audit cancellation completion and session-response admission; reconcile producer wire size contract without widening frozen bounds.
